name: Figma
body: Every image analyzed has alt text, security.txt is published, HSTS is preloaded, and robots.txt blocks GPTBot, CCBot and Google-Extended while answer bots may read. But /llms.txt answers with a 404.
lesson: Publish an llms.txt that lists your key pages with one-line summaries. Some AI tools read it first.
summary: www.figma.com scores 90 out of 100 (A). 1 check fails now, 11 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: 10 structured data items miss a property Google expects.

fix.title: 10 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /design/ Product lacks offers or review or aggregateRating, /make/ Product lacks offers or review or aggregateRating, /dev-mode/ Product lacks offers or review or aggregateRating and 7 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 35/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 14.4 s, Total Blocking Time 3077 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0, Speed Index 21.1 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 20 HTML documents are heavier than 500 KB
fix.fix: Move inline data and SVG out of the HTML.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.
